content.title: Dave Wright | Pattern's $300M IPO
content.description: Utah-based e-commerce player Pattern just pulled in $300 million in its IPO   pricing right in the middle of the range. The platform helps brands sell on retail giants like Amazon, Walmart, and Macy's. Pattern Co-Founder and CEO Dave Wright joined Bloomberg Open Interest to talk about the company's debut.

content.title: BofA’s Hartnett Says Magnificent 7 Stock Bubble Is Still Growing
content.summary: A BofA team led by Michael Hartnett studied 10 equity bubbles since the start of the previous century, finding that these periods of extreme overvaluation produced average trough-to-peak gains of 244%.  Current valuations also support the notion of further gains for the group, the strategists said.
